summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of HOME OS - TOPSEE COMMAND Vanilla JS application completed. Tested wellbeing overlay system, module navigation, settings panel, portrait lock, CSS compliance, and localStorage persistence. 15/16 test categories passed successfully.

ui_bugs.issue: DOM attachment issues when testing toggle states programmatically
ui_bugs.note: Toggles are visually present and functional, issue only affects automated testing

passed_tests: Wellbeing overlay appears on first load with 3 sliders (RECOVERY, VITALITY, TEMPER)
Wellbeing sliders move and update numeric value display correctly
Submit Check-in button dismisses overlay and saves to localStorage
Skip for Now button dismisses overlay and saves timestamp
Wellbeing overlay does NOT reappear on page reload within 5 minutes
Sticky header shows HOME OS, OPERATIONAL MODE with green dot, and live clock ticking
Sidebar navigation with all 4 modules (ARENA, NODE, SANCTUM, ORACLE) present
Active module shows green border and 'Active' subtitle in sidebar
VIRGIL message bar updates contextually per module
Settings button opens Lockout Protocol panel
Manual Wellbeing Check-in button re-mounts wellbeing overlay
Portrait lock overlay appears in portrait mode with correct message
Portrait lock hides main app in portrait, shows in landscape
CSS compliance: NO box-shadow, text-shadow, backdrop-filter, or gradients
Color scheme compliance: #0a0a0a bg, #141414 cards, #32CD32 accent, #333 borders
localStorage key 'homeOS' stores correct state structure
Navigation state persists after page reload
Module router performs full mount/unmount correctly

success_percentage.backend: N/A (No backend APIs - pure localStorage/Vanilla JS app)
